documents.summary: Graduate School guidance for committee-based exams, projects, theses and dissertations. It asks each program to set its own limits, strongly discourages over-reliance, requires disclosure and student responsibility, and gives four example program statements from partial permission to a full ban, plus privacy and copyright cautions.
